plot: In a distant future, Luna discovers a portal to an ancient world where she must stop a time-warping catastrophe.

personas.Luna: Bold and curious with a knack for solving ancient mysteries.
personas.Arlo: Quirky AI assistant who communicates only in riddles.

recap.Episode 1: Luna stumbles upon the portal and is transported to a new world.
recap.Episode 2: She learns about the impending disaster and begins her quest.
